resources.string: An independent LSPosed runtime layer module for supported Android apps.
Choose an application to view or configure its available hooks. Force-stop the application after changing settings.
You must also disable \"Force apps to show launcher icons\" in LSPosed Manager.
Activate Morphe LSPosed and select target applications in LSPosed Module Management before hooks can apply. You can still review and configure the listed settings.
Morphe LSPosed is an independent LSPosed runtime layer module for supported Android apps.\n\nIt is not affiliated with Morphe or ReVanced; please do not request support from their developers.
The catalog is metadata-only. Only reviewed Runtime Store layers already compiled into Morphe LSPosed can be added or enabled; no APK is built or modified.
